raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Princess Margaretha of Saxony’s mother as Archduchess Luise (Louise) of Austria-Tuscany, conflating her with a different Princess Margaretha/Margarete of Saxony. The visible Wikipedia result clearly stated her parents were King John of Saxony and Princess Amalie Auguste of Bavaria (born in Munich). This error led the team to research Luise’s birthplace (Salzburg) instead of Amalie Auguste’s (Munich), producing the wrong answer.
